tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: Head to the wooden pier at Şat Burnu, board the Sovalyece which will take you (free of charge) to Şövalye Island in under 10min and, finally, settle in at the chic ADA Restaurant. Your trip is rewarded with a dining experience with romance and charm in abundance. The views over the water and the city of Fethiye, the sound of the waves, the sunsets… Wonderful Turkish bread arrives immediately while you peruse the diverse menu. Succulent grilled sea bass with spicy roasted potatoes, smoked aubergine from the wood-fired oven with yoghurt, tandoori lamb or chicken curry: traditional Turkish cuisine is given a Mediterranean twist and presented in all its unembellished glory. Simply irresistible!
